_comment: Solution-style root. `files` is intentionally empty: this config only owns the
project graph. `tsc -b` walks it in dependency order.
apps/web is NOT in this graph on purpose — Next.js owns apps/web/tsconfig.json
and rewrites `noEmit: true` into it, which is incompatible with `composite`.
It is typechecked separately by the root `typecheck` script, still with TS 7.0.2.
